products.name: ICD Refinery
products.oneLiner: Turns messy, inconsistent interface control documents into a validated canonical spec — local-LLM extraction, deterministic linting, human approval, codec generation.
features: Local-LLM extraction that never touches the cloud

products.name: SIL Runtime
products.oneLiner: Fixed-step model execution for control software without hardware — deterministic MIL/SIL loops, stimulus injection, limit judgment.
features: C model loading via a stable native ABI

products.name: Test Sequencer
products.oneLiner: YAML test sequences → execution → pass/fail judgment → audit-ready HTML reports.

products.name: Telemetry Scope
products.oneLiner: Channel-defined live strip charts with recording and timed replay — replay a test exactly as it happened.
features: UDP / serial ingestion with engineering-unit scaling
0.1×–10× timed replay through the same pipeline

products.name: Ch10 Viewer
products.oneLiner: IRIG 106 Chapter 10 flight-test recording viewer — stream GB-class files, survive corruption, export channels.
features: Time / Analog / UART decode, CSV export

products.name: Protocol Bridge
products.oneLiner: Unattended channel mapping across Modbus, UDP, serial and MQTT — scale, deadband, reconnect, keep running.
features: Headless CLI with a minimal monitor

products.name: SECS/GEM Workbench
products.oneLiner: Semiconductor equipment↔host protocol decoder and simulator — HSMS sessions, SECS-II trees, host or equipment role.

products.name: RAM Toolkit
products.oneLiner: Reliability prediction, RBD availability and FMECA with audit-grade math trails — every number shows its formula.

products.name: Local Test Copilot
products.oneLiner: Air-gapped C unit-test generation — a local LLM proposes cases, gcc + gcov judge them, coverage gaps drive the loop.
